graph.title: Build a robot (HTML & CSS image positioning)
notes: This tutorial is a software-only HTML & CSS project (positioning robot face, eyes and mouth images with CSS in a browser editor). It has no Arduino, Raspberry Pi, breadboard, LEDs, wires or other physical parts, and no circuit images.
The robot, face, eyes and mouth are web images with ids like face, eyes1, eyes2, mouth1, not physical parts. I did not model them as nodes, so the graph is empty on purpose.
No external LED circuit is listed.
